assay: bulk RNA-seq of long-bone osteocyte-enriched fractions, mouse, Illumina NovaSeq 6000 (S4.16.p1, S11.p1)
sample_inclusion: 3 per genotype x sex x diet cell; KO female control sample 23 excluded for Y-chromosome reads / low Xist (S4.15.p1)
primary_estimand: Effect of FNDC5/irisin deletion (KO vs WT) and of sex on the osteocyte transcriptome, under control and low-calcium diet. No exercise intervention: exercise appears only as background on irisin as an exercise-induced myokine (ABS.p1, S1.p1, S1.p5).
planned_contrasts: WT F vs WT M (control diet) (S2.x, Supplementary file 3)
KO F vs WT F and KO M vs WT M (control diet) (Supplementary file 3)
KO lc vs WT lc within each sex (Supplementary file 4)
